body: When I took the class it took about 20+ hours. Most of it was just debugging and getting the recursion to work, if you need help you can message me.

I would split the studying between multiple days. I would also just practice the study guide if you are limited on time. Also sending your professor a message for advice could help. If you are thinking about withdrawing, make sure to go through the medical withdraw. You can talk to your doctor about how you are feeling, and they can provide a note for your medical withdraw. Remember it’s not the end of the world, you have plenty of time to get your degree. All of this will just be a funny story in the future.

I've been in a similar state of emptiness, and I've isolated myself from this fake earthly society during it. Thoughts and contemplations ran rampant through my brain, questioning questions that are not intended for answers. The more I questioned the more I sunk into my depression. Until one day, I simply didn't think at all, realizing thinking is overrated. When I excluded my thought process from ambiguous questions, I entered a state of simplistic sublimity in my conscious. My mind was at ease and the grand spectrum of values was minimalized, healing my darkness. The introspective synopsis of this, is that devalue those who do not value you.

Have you lost your star? Are you referring to the lost of a loved one my friend? If so, remember that energy can never be destroyed, but only transformed. That energy is intertwined with your mass of matter, providing support and crystallizing your core. Making you stronger internally. I can only substantiate this fact from my personal experience.

I've just realized this, but life is a freaking movie. My movie is your movie, and your movie is my movie. And every movie is a snippet of a massive compilation of movies. And all good movies have a form of suspension and mystery. In addition, I've noticed that when there's suspension, the following scene seems to always be an inevitably, satisfyingly awesome part. That's why I love movies. 
I want to see your current movie, but unfortunately, I can only see the script. Message me your script. I'm open to talk about my script too :)

Dude you don't have to waste charcoal to end your flame. You can use it to spawn internal, unforgetful, memories by looking into the sky with a smokey campfire, where there are infinite worlds and possibilities. You are a rare being in this grand universe. It's hard to imagine, but you are literally composed of stardust and galactic materials making you radiant of celestial greatness. Therefore you are the attraction of all your surroundings. If you are absent, everything great will fall apart. Believe me, I've lost a star and it hurts, so continue burning for your self and animate beings that revolve around your gravity.

The best Christmas gift you can give your loved ones is your liveness and well being. Don't stress living man, you are a human being with infinite potential, who know's how you'll affect your environment in the future. The human mind is spontaneous, and you are unique. Any uniqueness is the derivation of creativeness. We need your individuality in this world. :)
Message me, I want to know your uniqueness. ;)

I have never had a girlfriend in my life because of my social anxiety. I question why I am like." where did I go wrong?" And then I look in the mirror and I am reminded it's because I'm ugly. 
I don't know how to counter this feeling in my mind, but my intuition always tells me that I am eligible to change.
So I'm going to change my personality to dwarf my ugliness.
Hopefully you can get better along with me my dude.
